"Extremely Unprofessional and Dishonest Experience"
​I had a terrible experience with Vardhman Jewellers in Parel. We went on Dec 11, 2025, to extend my wife's mangalsutra chain, handing over 6.1g of old gold and 15.7 gm Mangalsutra with a promised return date of Dec 14.

​Illegal Credit Card Surcharge: They charged an extra ₹200 for a credit card transaction and refused to show this charge on the bill. This is against RBI guidelines and is an unfair trade practice.
​Avoidance of GST Bill: The owner actively tried to convince us not to take a GST bill. Always insist on a bill, especially when handing over old gold, as they use "no-bill" transactions to play around with the gold value.

​Save your time and money. I would strongly recommend going to a branded, transparent jeweller rather than this local shop where trust is clearly not a priority.
